name: The Spears of Dothea
background:
In the outskirts of the known galaxy, this force of tribesmen turned Battle Brothers struggles to survive. Their tactics are both feral and extremely well controlled, and their forces are varied. They fight alongside an old ally that stands with them on the edge of the galaxy, supplying them with old-world tech and war-machines.
This faction focuses on having both a strong melee presence, as well as artillery and aircraft to support them.  The heroes of this force compliment the fighting style of the Spears and can support either the front or back lines.
backgroundFull:
The Spears of Dothea dwell on their secluded world, a blend of tribal culture and advanced technology. Dothea, their sacred planet, is a rugged landscape teeming with ancient wisdom and primal energy.

Their moon, Aethir, houses the Moonforgers, who provide them with advanced weaponry and war machines. This union of primal knowledge and technology defines the Spears' unique prowess.

In the face of galactic conflicts encroaching on their isolation, the Spears unite under a fierce Warhost Lord. Their fighting style, seemingly savage, conceals a calculated and strategic approach born from rigorous training.

Their mission: defend Dothea and its traditions while wielding the advanced tools gifted by the Moonforgers. The Spears of Dothea stand as a formidable force, blending tribal roots with calculated precision, feared and respected across the stars.

spells.effectSkirmish: Target 4 friendly units within 12"move +1" when using Advance, or +2" when using Rush/Charge once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.effect: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 2 hits with AP(2).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 1 hit with AP(2).

spells.effectSkirmish: Target 4 enemy units within 18" get -2 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores cover.

specialRules.name: Defense Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Protected
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Evasive
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where all models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Quake
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and on unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Ballistic Vest
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Ballistic Vest Boost Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Ballistic Vest Boost.

specialRules.name: Ballistic Vest Boost
specialRules.description: If all models in this unit have Ballistic Vest, enemy hits always count as having AP(-1) from Ballistic Vest (instead of only when being shot/charged from over 9" away).

specialRules.name: Good Attacker
specialRules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Demolish
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and against units where most models have Tough(3) to Tough(9), this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Rending when shooting.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Melee Evasion.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Hit & Run.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Counter in melee.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Precision Shooting Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

specialRules.name: Speed Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Boost
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Hit & Run, they may move by up to 6" from Hit & Run (instead of only 3").

specialRules.name: Speed Boost
specialRules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +4” when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: No Retreat Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

specialRules.name: Piercing Fighting Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Reinforced
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Fast
specialRules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +4” when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next tough model (heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Rending
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and on unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
specialRules.description: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run
specialRules.description: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: Strikes first with this weapon when charged, and the charging unit gets -1 total Impact rolls per model with Counter.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified results of 6 to hit in melee deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 12” of their deployment zone. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.
